operations.old:
KEEP Action/V/S/F, base 17 RP, one instantaneous 60-foot cone from the caster, and all four categories: hidden traps, enemies, magic and lies. NEW choose and record the cone direction at commitment; the caster alone receives the resolution-time snapshot, with no creature-count cap. The cone is an informational area, not a sight-required individual targeting attempt. Hidden or Invisible unprotected contents can qualify. Source-origin line of effect clips each readable portion; a wall cannot be bypassed merely because another sense sees through it.

NEW exact fallback template, because the supplied combat guide leaves exact templates open: use a cone with 60-foot forward axial length and circular cross-section of diameter equal to distance along its axis (diameter 60 feet at its far end). Record an actual origin and facing vector before the cast. On the existing 5-foot grid, use cell centers in that volume; a body/feature qualifies through a genuinely occupied included cell and only its readable local footprint is disclosed. Do not include a creature merely because an empty corner of its rectangular bounding box touches the volume. The origin cell itself is excluded; a source may choose a forward origin on its own actual space boundary. This is a NEW DI7 template choice, not recovered ordinary cone text. Existing range metric, total-cover, actual vertical placement and no-corner-cutting constraints still apply; this template gives no generic new geometry to other spells.

Hidden traps: reveal the current physical site, occupied footprint, armed/dormant state and immediate trigger category of every actual readable trap. A concealed plate qualifies; an ordinary dangerous creature is not automatically a trap. No disarm solution, code, future die or automatic Search/disarm Action is granted. Enemies: reveal the current occupied footprint and readable creature count of actual beings presently intending or executing a meaningful hostile act against the caster or a member of the caster's current party. This NEW predicate is not alignment, species, reputation, mere disagreement or a caller's enemy flag. It reads no plan, memory, full identity or stat block. Intent, location and existence protections retain their independent actual scopes; never count protected existences.

Magic: reveal each current actual magical effect's local footprint, spell/nonspell category, generating school/rank when its source supplies them, and active/suppressed state. A dormant enchanted object's still-existing enchantment may be distinguished from an active spell when readable; this does not invent charges, attunement, powers or an absent school/rank. Overlapping effects stay separate. Lies: NEW examine assertions made during the inclusive six elapsed seconds ending at resolution by a creature presently in the readable cone, only where the caster actually perceived and understood that assertion. Report deliberate deception when the speaker knowingly asserted what they then believed false; a sincere error is not a lie. Irony, uncertainty, misunderstood content, mere recorded sounds or a speaker now outside the area create no invented belief or objective replacement truth. Current relevant belief/existence protections still apply. A valid decoded sign can be an assertion; the spell supplies no language or general translation.

No generic save is added. An actual defense's own check/threshold applies only within its source scope. Apply the shared information rule without a free preflight search for hidden facts. The spell disarms, dispels, damages and compels nothing. CORRECTION to the proposal's blanket retained-concealment language: learning a location ends Hidden for this caster and removes Invisible's own attack modifiers against this informed observer, as already reviewed; it does not make an Invisible creature visible or satisfy a sight-required spell. Independent concealment still applies. The record is a snapshot, not a tracking feed. No ally receives the knowledge or observer-state change without actually obtaining that information through a legal channel.

operations.old:
KEEP Action/V/S/F/base 17 RP, range 120 feet, instantaneous reading, and all past and present magical effects in an area. NEW choose a perceived point within 120 feet and line of effect; at resolution use one fixed 20-foot-radius sphere and current center-to-portion line of effect, with the reviewed grid metric for membership. Solid total cover clips the readable portion. This is a spatial-history query of those actual readable places, not a remote view through today's walls; a presently open portion can still reveal its established earlier local history even if the ancient layout differed.

Privately receive every actual established magical-effect occurrence whose historical footprint intersected those readable spatial portions while the event existed, plus current readable magic there. There is no arbitrary lookback age, rank or record-count ceiling. An ended/destroyed effect remains eligible as history, including one that ended long ago; destruction does not recreate a present object or resource. The Director's actual established history is sufficient without a previously implemented event log, but absence of historical evidence is not proof of no ancient magic. NEW interval representation: one continuing unchanged effect is one interval with its genuinely known transitions, not a generated casting every second. A moving effect has its real local visits/intervals, not a new spell per tile; overlaps retain separate original effect identities.

For each readable occurrence give its actual spell/effect identity, or its established bounded category when no named identity is supplied; generating school/rank only when its source actually defines those fields; readable local footprint; time/relative ordering at its real established precision; and starts, persistence, changes, suppression and endings there. Actual magical nonspell class/item effects and existing dormant enchantments can qualify through their real magic/history, without inventing rank 0 or a school. A record that was never magical is not made magical by nearby events. An effect currently elsewhere has only its local historical footprint here, not a disclosed current remote destination.

This does not automatically reveal a caster's personal identity, private memory, current pool, attunement, full blueprint, upstream origin or unrelated history. Those require their own actual readable manifestation/source permission. Apply each genuine present/historical information defense to the facts and time intervals it really covers: a current-only ward does not retroactively erase unrelated old history; an express historical-trace protection still applies. Do not disclose protected existence through count, placeholders, missing sequence numbers or conspicuous gaps. Undefined precision stays uncertain rather than being rounded into an invented date. Supply all independently useful readable information, not only public facts or a single trace.

The snapshot can be remembered/recorded through ordinary time and tools. It grants no ongoing sensory feed, targeting sight, time travel, replay, dispel, reconstruction, spell acquisition or Fate Echo observation receipt. Learning a cast's past existence now is not directly witnessing that original cast in its original time window. Equivalent unchanged paid inquiries return consistent overlapping records; genuine new events/protection/evidence can change them. No spent material, soul, class permission or cosmological origin is recovered or interpreted.
